--all-tests.help: run all tests regardless of staged changes

--cert.help: Path to the IDP cert. If the file doesn't exist a new cert and keypair will be created.

--ci.help: informs beagle that it is running in a CI container

--disable-generation.help: informs beagle to not run code generation steps

--enable-pprof.help: Enable the pprof HTTP sampling server.

--foss-only.help: forces the build context to scope down to the BloodHound Community repository only.

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--key.help: Path to the IDP key. If the file doesn't exist a new cert and keypair will be created.

--migrate.help: Only perform database migrations. Do not start the server.

--num-rels.help: Number of simple relationships to create.

--skip-argon2.help: Offset automatic argon2 tuning. Only applies to creating new configurations.

--test.help: Test to run. Must be one of: 'postgres', 'neo4j', 'both'

--tuneMillis.help: number of milliseconds to tune to

--upload-coverage.help: uploads a new copy of coverage profiles to S3. This flag is only used for CI runs.

--url.help: The base URL to the IDP.

build.help: Bump the build part of the version

check.help: Checks if a string is a valid semver version

major.help: Bump the major part of the version

minor.help: Bump the minor part of the version

nextver.help: Determines the next version, taking prereleases into account.

patch.help: Bump the patch part of the version

prerelease.help: Bump the prerelease part of the version
